# Audiment – Product Overview

## What is Audiment?
Audiment is audit management software for multi-location businesses. It helps operations teams run audits with photo evidence, track corrective actions to resolution, and maintain operational consistency across every branch.

## Core Capabilities
- **Photo Evidence:** Audit questions can require live photos. Gallery uploads are disabled on evidence items.
- **Auditor Presence Verification:** GPS checks and a short on-site video confirm the auditor was at the location.
- **Corrective Action Tracking:** When an audit item fails, a task is auto-created with a resolution deadline. Managers upload photo proof of the fix.
- **Multi-Location Dashboards:** Compare scores across branches, regions, and time periods. See which locations are trending down.
- **FSSAI Templates:** Pre-built templates for Indian food safety regulations.
- **Offline-First:** Auditors can complete inspections without connectivity. Data syncs when back online.

## Who Uses Audiment
Multi-location businesses: QSR chains, restaurant groups, retail chains, hotel groups, franchise networks, and manufacturing facilities. Primary users are operations directors, area managers, and compliance teams.

## How Audiment Is Different
Unlike generic checklist tools, Audiment verifies that audits were completed on-site with evidence, tracks issues through to resolution, and gives leadership visibility across all locations from a single dashboard.
